config.script:
userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	
	operatorInfo = self.view.custom.operatorInfo
	if operatorInfo['endDate'] and system.date.isBefore(operatorInfo['endDate'], operatorInfo['startDate']):
		system.perspective.print('Invalid date range')
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', 'Invalid date range')
		return
	
	crewMemberId, msg = system.kanoa.operators.addCrewMember(self.view.custom.operatorInfo, userId)
	if msg:
		system.perspective.print("addCrewMember() failed: %s"%msg)
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', 'addMemberCrew() failed: %s'%msg)
	else:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', 'Crew member has been added')
		
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.crewMembers.data")
		
	return

userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	crewMemberId = self.view.custom.crewMembers.selection.data[0].crewMemberId
	retVal, msg = system.kanoa.operators.deleteCrewMember(crewMemberId, userId)
	if msg:
		system.perspective.print("deleteCrewMember() failed: %s"%msg)
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', 'deleteCrewMember() failed: %s'%msg)
	else:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', 'Crew member has been deleted')

	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.crewMembers.data")
	
	return

userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	crewMemberId = self.view.custom.crewMembers.selection.data[0].crewMemberId
	retVal, msg = system.kanoa.operators.removeCrewMember(crewMemberId, system.date.now(), userId)
	if msg:
		system.perspective.print("removeCrewMember() failed: %s"%msg)
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', 'removeCrewMember() failed: %s'%msg)
	else:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', 'Crew member has been removed')

	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.crewMembers.data")
	
	return
